name: Ragna Lothbrok
original_name: 拉格纳 · 罗德布洛克
source: Ragna visited the orphanage where little Bianka lived and taught the kids gardening. Later, Murata Himeko arrived there to recruit for St. Freya, meeting with a resistance from angered Bianka, but Himeko told her that she wants to honor Ragna and her ideals, she should take on the fight herself as a Valkyrie.
